scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: How about grabbing something from the convenience store? It’s easy, and it’s already getting late.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Sure♪ Convenience store bentos have gotten really tasty lately!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: They enter a nearby convenience store and browse through their favorite bentos and side dishes.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: What are you getting, Megumi? Maybe the fried chicken bento?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: I’ll go with the nori bento♪ What about you, {{playerName}}-senpai?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: I’ll stick with the classic fried chicken bento. Oh, and maybe we should get some dessert too.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: While browsing, an in-store announcement begins to play.

scenarios.speaker: Store Announcement
scenarios.text: 『Special Summer Travel Plans! Book early and get 20% off! From hot springs to overseas trips—we’ve got amazing deals...』

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Oh, they’re talking about travel♪ That reminds me...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Travel, huh... Just imagining going on a trip with Megumi makes my heart race.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai, if I win the M1GP, let’s go on a celebration trip together!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: What!? An invitation from Megumi!? This... this makes me so happy!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: That sounds awesome! Let’s definitely go!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yay♪ So then, {{playerName}}-senpai, where would you like to go?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Where would you like to travel to?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yay♪ It’s a promise! I’ll win the M1GP no matter what, and we’ll go on that trip together!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: I can’t believe how happy she looks... I really need to support her as much as I can.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: It’s a promise! I’ll be your mentor and support you all the way to victory.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you♪ With you by my side, {{playerName}}-senpai, I know we can create something amazing!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: And so, {{playerName}} and Megumi’s joint development project enters a new phase. Their bond continues to deepen, along with their feelings for each other. Will they really win the M1GP and go on that promised trip...?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Time passes... and finally, the day of the lab trip and M1GP presentation arrives.
